# RelicLLM

> Multi-GPU inference runtime for older accelerators: model implementations, serving adapters and schedulers on PyTorch, over the relic-core operator library

This is the index of every page the documentation site publishes. It is generated from `mkdocs.yml`
by `scripts/gen_llms_txt.py`; edit the nav, not this file, and re-run the script.

## Pages

- [Home](https://lvyufeng.github.io/RelicLLM/)
- [Getting started](https://lvyufeng.github.io/RelicLLM/getting-started/)
